notes: Encoded the two computable arithmetic bounds the contract states: limit > 0 (positive integer) and offset >= 0 (non-negative, 0-based). Both use cmp on optional fields so they skip when omitted (zero false-positives). Left to the LLM ceiling / schema floor: file_path absoluteness (open-set string predicate, not a relational contract a validator proves from arithmetic), type/required/max bounds (schema floor), and pages-range validity (free-form string, not computable here).

Encoded the one computable relational contract: old_string != new_string (replacing a string with itself is a rejected no-op). Left to the LLM ceiling: whether old_string actually occurs in the file, uniqueness of the match when replace_all is false, and path validity — none are computable from call arguments alone. Type/required/boolean checks are deferred to the schema floor.

Empty: Write has only two required string args (file_path, content), both covered by the schema floor; no relational/arithmetic/ordering/exactly-one-of contract exists. Absolute-path validity and content correctness are open-set semantic checks left to the LLM ceiling.

Encoded the one computable relational contract the schema floor cannot express: timeout >= 0 (non-negative), via cmp/ge which skips when timeout is omitted. The upper bound (<=600000), types, and required-ness are left to the schema floor; command meaningfulness, sandbox-disable safety, and background-execution semantics are open-set/semantic and left to the LLM ceiling.

Encoded the non-negative lower bound on optional timeout (cmp ge 0, skips when omitted). Left the upper bound (<=600000), types, required, and booleans to the schema floor; left command content semantics (safety, sandbox/dangerouslyDisableSandbox intent, background-run appropriateness) to the LLM ceiling as open-set/semantic contracts.

Encoded the six non-negativity bounds the contract states (-A, -B, -C, context, head_limit, offset all >= 0) as cmp/ge, which skip silently when the optional field is omitted (zero false-positives). Left to the schema floor: pattern required, output_mode enum membership, and all type checks. Left to the LLM ceiling: open-set string fields (pattern regex validity, path/glob/type values) and the semantic redundancy of -C vs -A/-B, none of which is a computable relational contract from the arguments alone.

Empty: the contract explicitly states no computable relational contract beyond the schema floor. Both params are free-form open-set strings (pattern, optional path) with no arithmetic/cardinality/ordering/mutual-exclusion relationship; pattern validity and path-vs-pattern semantics are left to the LLM ceiling.

Encoded the computable cardinality contract: 1 <= len(questions) <= 4 via cmp on {"len":"questions"} (skips safely if questions is undefined). Left to the LLM ceiling: question/option semantic quality, free-form text content, and per-option correctness — none of which are provable from call arguments alone.

Empty: the contract states no relational contract beyond the schema floor. 'query' required and 'max_results' positive-integer are type/required/min bounds already covered by the schema floor; there is no cross-argument arithmetic, ordering, cardinality, or exactly-one-of relationship to encode. Query-semantics (open-set string matching) are left to the LLM ceiling.

Empty: contract states no computable relational contract beyond the schema floor. 'skill' is an open string set (exact skill names — new ones are legal, can't be enum-bounded here) and 'args' is free-form; the type/required floor already covers them. Skill-name existence and arg semantics are left to the LLM ceiling.

Empty: every stated contract is already covered by the schema floor (required description/prompt/subagent_type; enum on model=sonnet|opus|haiku and isolation=worktree) or is explicitly non-computable (subagent_type is an OPEN set — left to the LLM ceiling). No relational/arithmetic/cardinality/ordering/exactly-one-of contracts exist among the args to encode.

Encoded the one computable relational contract: messages array length >= 1 (non-empty). Left the per-element {role,content} structure, role-enum, and free-form content/model/system string semantics to the schema floor and the LLM ceiling (open-set fields).

Encoded the input-source exactly-one-of ({text|source_path|items} count=1, holds for every valid call) plus relational numeric bounds (threshold in [0,1], per_file_max_chars in [1000,200000]) as skip-on-undefined cmp guards. Left labels-required/types/enums to the schema floor and the open-set semantics (label set quality, frame text, model name, allow_none policy) to the LLM ceiling.
